Tankyrase-2 is a protease that plays a role in chromatin remodeling and is associated with various pathological conditions, including cancer. The integration of these targets implies that Ludongnin G may act through Protoxylocarpin E to inhibit Tankyrase-2, potentially affecting chromatin structure and cellular processes.
